title: Continuation-on-fail must also bind wave-planner/carryover scopes — cycle-1078 had no inbox item to stamp
notes: G2 from the first live FAIL under the convergence stack (cycle-1078, 2026-07-23): the failing lane's scope (chain-boundary-loop) came from the wave planner / carryoverTodos, NOT an inbox claim — no item file exists in .evolve/inbox, so the FAIL-release stamping has no target and ResolveContinuation can never bind the preserved snapshot to a future attempt. Slice C currently covers ONLY inbox-claimed scopes. Design the extension: (a) persist the continuation binding keyed by the SCOPE ID (lane-scope todo ids) in a small root-owned registry (or stamp into the carryoverTodos entry in state.json through the existing serialized RMW), and (b) teach the post-triage adoption seam to also resolve by the cycle's lane-scope ids when no processing claim carries a stamp. Keep the single continuation schema (internal/continuation); do NOT fork a second manifest format. The G1 half (error-path stamping) is implemented and CI-green in PR #363 — verify it is merged before assuming G1 on main; this item is ONLY the non-claim binding and does not depend on #363 landing first.
